div.head: Ine 3.1
div.ab: Gif þonne se þeowa buton his gewitnesse wyrce, ðolie his hyde (oððe hydgyld[es]).
Gif þonne se ðeowa butan his gewitnesse wyrce, þolie his hyde.
Si seruus sine testimonio domini sui operetur, corium perdat.
Gif þonne se ðeowa butan his gewitnesse wyrce, þolie his hyde.
If, however, the slave works without his [lord’s] knowledge, let [the slave] pay with his hide
If, however, the slave works without the cognisance of his master, he shall undergo the lash or pay the fine in lieu thereof
If, however, the slave works without his knowledge, he is to be flogged.
Wenn aber der Sklav ohne Mitwissen desselben arbeitet, verliere er seine Haut (oder Hautgeld).
But if the slave works without the knowledge of that [lord], let him lose his hide (or hide-money).

note.label: cf.
note.quote: Wihtred §8.1 [L10] allows a payment to the esne's master of 6 shillings to avoid being whipped.

div.note: C.C.C.C., MS. 383, adds: “or (pay) the ‘hide-price’”, i.e. the sum to save him from being flogged.
